notablePrerequisites: Kelpie Guide and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
